scientific_integrity: Proof provides exact model assumptions, normalization, renewal identities, and boundary Tauberian and renewal-density arguments; numerical verification supplements but does not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Only three mean-current critical exponents for pure-Pareto global resets of infinite-volume step-initial SEP; finite-size crossover, variances and full distributions not classified. The closest 2022 paper provides general renewal transforms and may enable independent derivation; publication priority is not independently certified.
title: Three exact marginal logarithmic transport laws in power-law-reset exclusion dynamics
